name: MockupPhonePortrait
description: a box area that looks like a mobile phone
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `role="img"` with `aria-label` identifies the mockup as a phone frame representation
Screen readers announce the label to describe the mockup context
keyboard: Tab: Focus moves to interactive elements within the phone content
(The phone frame itself is not interactive)
props: `label`: string (required) -- accessible name describing the phone mockup
`children`: slot (required) -- content displayed within the phone screen area
`...restProps`: unknown -- additional attributes spread onto the `<div>` element
